prompt: Since the Money serializer was added to this Spring Boot 4 catalog API, three parts of the JSON contract broke: responses contain "description": null instead of omitting it, requests with unknown fields are accepted although application.properties says they must be rejected, and error responses nest our "code" under "properties" (and add "type": null) instead of making it a top-level member of the problem document. Restore the whole contract while keeping prices in the "12.50 EUR" format. Configuration belongs in application.properties, not in hand-written mapper settings. Run the tests with `sh test.sh` (Maven works offline: every dependency is already in ~/.m2).
